chapter_seo_title: An Invitation to a Celestial Immortal’s Estate – Desolate Era Chapter 254
chapter_meta_description: ShaoYan Nong invites Ji Ning and his crew to explore a Celestial Immortal’s lair. Sword arts, danger, and a war-galley await—but is the price worth the prize?
og_title: A Celestial Immortal’s estate awaits in Desolate Era Chapter 254
og_description: Ji Ning gears up for the ultimate ruin-dive: a Daemon Sword Immortal’s untouched estate. But even Primal-tier godbeasts aren’t enough protection…
twitter_title: An untouched Celestial Immortal estate just dropped into Ji Ning’s lap
twitter_description: Sword arts for the taking, danger guaranteed—ShaoYan Nong’s invitation is too good to refuse.

lore_anchors.definition: The sixth major realm of Ki Refining; a transcendent being who has survived the Heavenly Tribulation and escaped the Five Elements cycle, gaining a literally boundless lifespan.
One of the Four Young Masters of the Grand Xia Imperial Capital, from the ancient ShaoYan clan. Known for his polished diplomacy and deep resources.

A pivotal fight in Xianxia where a rising cultivator clashes with an established powerhouse to a close result or retreat, functionally announcing their arrival as a major figure regardless of final outcome.
A top-tier godbeast that can only take human form at the Primal Daoist stage; far nobler than common godbeasts like the Skygreen Serpent.
